name: dayflow-qa
description: Independent QA test repository for DayFlow — API/integration, web E2E, and (future) mobile UI tests, run against QA's own isolated stack.

scripts.stack:up: npm run checkout:dev-ref && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --env-file .env.test up -d --build && node scripts/wait-for-health.mjs
scripts.stack:reset-api: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --env-file .env.test restart api-qa && node scripts/wait-for-health.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:batch1: playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/daily-journal.spec.ts e2e/login-gate.spec.ts e2e/month-view-data.spec.ts e2e/note-sheets.spec.ts e2e/time-lock.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:batch2: playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/notes-save-behavior.spec.ts e2e/todo-due-date.spec.ts e2e/todo-persistence.spec.ts e2e/view-mode-persistence.spec.ts e2e/view-modes.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:batch1 && npm run stack:reset-api && npm run test:e2e:batch2 && npm run stack:reset-api && npm run test:e2e:batch3
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run stack:reset-api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.prodcheck:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml -f docker-compose.prodcheck.yml --env-file .env.test up -d api-qa-prodcheck api-qa-prodcheck-baddb
scripts.prodcheck:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml -f docker-compose.prodcheck.yml --env-file .env.test rm -sf api-qa-prodcheck api-qa-prodcheck-baddb
